description: This PHP class 'Membership' extends 'NormalizableDTO' and represents a data transfer object (DTO) related to memberships within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It provides methods to convert membership data to an array format and defines mappings for fields to their respective getter methods.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: A DTO class representing membership information, capable of normalizing and converting membership data to an array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Membership DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array representation of the employee's memberships based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to their respective getter method sequences for retrieving data.
